task: Matthew has sent me a message on phone regarding some amazon order. I am forgetting the details. Do as requested as per their last message.

data.message: Hey it was great having lunch with you today!

Can you please order following items from amazon at your home for me? I'll pick them up when I visit you.
- 1 X Smartwool Hike Medium Crew Socks
- 2 X Darn Tough Hiker Micro Crew Cushion Socks
- 1 X Darn Tough Coolmax Vertex Tab Ultra-Light Cushion Socks
- 1 X Darn Tough Mountaineering Over-The-Calf Extra Cushion Socks

Also, please send me a venmo request for the total amount you had to pay for the order. Thanks!
I'm thinking of redecorating my room. Any suggestions?
How about a minimalist theme with some cozy lighting? It creates a relaxing ambiance.
That's a cool idea! I'll look into it.
Unfortunately, I have a prior meeting, but I can catch up afterward.
No worries, we'll fill you in on the ideas discussed.
Hey, I accidentally spilled some coffee on the living room rug. Sorry!
No worries, accidents happen. I'll clean it up.
Thanks, I'll help you with it.
